atb.review: It is possible to attain an A. If you only attend his classes, you'll walk out with at least a B+. He is very easygoing, marks very leniently, and makes literature easy to understand.
AtB is the bestest, very helpful and explains very well. Well organized with the study materials.

khu.review: KHU drop drop drop! She is very strict and gives tons of assignments.

Now I’m convinced I hallucinated the entire semester I did classes with KHU! The sweetest, kindest, most supportive faculty ever, appreciated my work, full marks on every submission, and I ended up with an easy A.

Both KHU and PMZ are very helpful faculties. They are always available for students, never make you feel unreasonable about questions, and are kind and supportive. I had to study hard in their major courses, but both are excellent choices.

stsd.review: She's extremely biased. If you want a deserving grade, make sure she knows you well and talk to her about random stuff.
STSD will ruin your whole semester. Worst ever.

mz.review: I'm not sure if it's the same Mahfuza Zannat (MZ), but if it is, she is not suited to be an educator. She doesn't seem to value creativity and emphasizes memorizing passages from the book and reproducing them word for word. The highest grade she gave our section was B, even to a strong writer who deserved more.

Her approach relies heavily on rote memorization from the guidebook rather than encouraging creativity. She introduced the quiz topic on the day of the quiz, did not appreciate high-level writing, and marked essays based on topics she personally liked. The highest grade in our section was B.

ndm.review: He is not good at teaching and final questions were very tough. He may curve a little.

pmz.review: PMZ mam is very easygoing and really helpful. You can email or visit her whenever you need help, but you have to put in effort to get a good grade.
PMZ drop drop drop! She gives 0 the minute she notices AI-written assignments. She's not easygoing at all!
PMZ and KHU are both kind, helpful, and supportive. They are not necessarily easygoing, since their major courses require hard work, but students are in good hands with either.

fhs.review: If you are from Bangla medium, go for FHS.
FHS ma'am is best. She curves a lot and will give you a good grade for sure; she believes GED courses shouldn't be too painful.

ssa2.review: He is good, but he lost my midterm script and never showed it before finals. Otherwise, he is good, but he said attendance would not be strict and then it was.
He does fair grading and is very chill. Follow his rules and you'll be good to go.

sou.review: Drop SOU if you want to save your money. Don't ask me why.
SOU teaches well and is very strict. She focuses a lot on grammar and vocabulary.
SOU is goated for both learning and grading.
In my experience she's like Waliul Sir in O-levels. Actively interact with her, and if your grammar is good, you'll be fine.
She's lenient with marks. Communicate well with her and that should be enough to get A/A-. She doesn't give C or D; below-average students still get B. She teaches very well and is a sweetheart.
SOU was described as goated for both learning and grading.

shq.review: SHQ does not seem easygoing. When I took ENG103 with him, he said he doesn't curve and eventually didn't.
I did ENG103 under him. It is hard to survive his course, but he grades fairly and gives the raw grade you earn.
SHQ is not easygoing. He says he doesn't curve, and grades are raw.

ruj.review: She is the best. Her instructions and teaching style are perfect, and she is a sweetheart.
She gives deserving grades. Follow the format and structure and she will give you the marks. She will explain something repeatedly if you don't understand.
It was a great semester with RUJ. Teaching and assessment were effective and well organized. One of the best faculty for learning.
One of the best faculty for this course, both for fair grading and learning.
She's the best for learning. She makes sure the concepts are clear and is easy to talk to.
She loves to give marks generously, but you must follow her simple writing structure. She focuses on important material, remembers students' names, and is understanding and supportive.
RUJ is a gem and quite lenient. Follow her instructions and you will get a good grade.

ftn.review: FTN is really sweet and easygoing, but you may not get the grade you expect.

hme.review: HMe sir is a great person, my favorite. He teaches very well in a cool way, though I've heard he grades strictly.
HME is best! If you can adjust to his humor and think out of the box, you'll do well.

zkh1.review: ZKH1 sir teaches well but grades hard. Take special care with the presentation and viva. He is not biased.
ZKH1 is good, but usually gives B+. You need to do exceptionally well for an A-.

szp.review: SZP is a wonderful soul. With minimum effort and by following her instructions, you can get good grades. Participate in class and don't use your phone.
